0022600125.text: The Houston Rockets, 3-0 and first in the Southwest, host the Atlanta Hawks, who are 2-1 and first in the Southeast, in the fourth game of the Rockets' season. Houston has won all three of its games this season, including a 1-0 record at home, while Atlanta is 0-1 at home and comes in on a one-game losing streak. The Rockets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 121-114 win in Atlanta on October 24, and they also won both meetings in the 2025-26 season series 2-0. Houston is without Marcus Smart (out, forearm strain) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture).
